quest.rewards_formatted: Records of the Gallant: The Hermit x1

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can go on adventures without a Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: You mean be one of those martial arts heroes? Hmph, no thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: After the old folks in the village discovered I had an interest in adventuring, they kept bringing me all these martial arts novels...

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: But when I read them, I was disappointed to find that the main characters are all ugly stinking men! Sorry, not my kind of story!

dialogues.speaker: Little Liu
dialogues.text: You haven't read any before? Here, knock yourself out, they're certainly no use to me!
